verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that lets users build audiences, manage and create syncs, design journeys, generate ads and analyze performance "all in plain language," with concrete example prompts. A built-in agent also lets users explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operation works as claimed, and evidence that the in-app agent goes beyond exploration and analysis (resource creation is shown only through an external MCP-connected assistant).
